title: Sai Life Sciences Limited (NSE: SAILIFE) — Integrated Global CRDMO Underwriting & Valuation Stress-Test
subtitle: Compounder Pass (Watch) — Rejected (Tier 0) on 102.35x P/E & H1 Cash-Flow Stress; 0 Shares Held
holding_rationale: SAILIFE is not held (0 shares) in our Zerodha India book as of the November 23, 2026 ledger (last trade November 25). Zerodha holds 18 stocks worth ₹28,43,355.05 plus ₹14,20,949.94 in cash, or 33.32% of ₹42,64,304.99 net worth. Sai Life retains a Compounder Pass (Watch) franchise rating on 19 top-25 pharma accounts and 11-for-11 USFDA/PMDA audits. Yet new capital is Rejected (Tier 0) on Valuation and Cash Flow at ₹1,799.30 live TV (₹1,809.10 NSE close; 102.35x TTM P/E, 14.22x P/B). Pass 1 flagged a 6–9 month Bidar Block 2 delay to early Q3 FY28 and zero commercial peptide capacity today. H1 FY27 FCF dropped to -₹371.16 Cr alongside ₹417.94 Cr current debt, ₹100 Cr new November 24 term loans, and ₹511.1 Cr unbilled assets. Realistic FY29E earnings (₹24.50 EPS) at 75.5x cap Base fair value at ₹1,850 (expected value ₹1,775). That leaves just 0.12:1 R:R at CMP and 0.25:1 at live support (₹1,640.45–₹1,756.48 vs. ₹1,377.68 stop), failing our 1.50:1 hurdle.

holding_alerts.instruction: Passive research alert only (no buy order): if a multi-quarter valuation reset brings NSE:SAILIFE into ₹1,250–₹1,350 (~51x–55x FY29E Base EPS of ₹24.50), re-open underwriting to test whether cash conversion (>75% CFO/EBITDA) and Bidar Block 1 commercial revenue have recovered.

Passive technical alert only (0 shares held): a decisive weekly close below ₹1,377.68 (breaching Pivot S1 ₹1,415.40 and 30-week SMA ₹1,414.28) confirms Stage 2 uptrend breakdown and extends the digestion window.
